record.what_it_does: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support/helpdesk platform for managing tickets, contacts, companies, agents, and knowledge-base content.
record.auth_notes: Freshdesk uses a per-agent 'API key' sent via HTTP Basic Auth (API key as username, any string as password) or as a bearer-style token in the Authorization header for the MCP integration. No OAuth2 is documented for the core REST API.
record.access_notes: New signups get a 14-day free trial (no credit card) with full API key access; there is no ongoing free public plan for new accounts (a separate 'Free Program' exists only for existing accounts, capped at 2 agents and 6 months). After the trial, a paid plan (Blossom/Garden/Estate/Forest or newer Growth/Pro/Enterprise tiers) is required for continued API use.
record.main_blocker: No permanent free tier (trial-only), and the official MCP server is Enterprise-plan-only via a gated Early Access Program

evidence.quote: You can use your personal API key to authenticate the request. If you use the API key, there is no need for a password.
Currently, Freshdesk allows you to authenticate requests involved in MCP integration by using an API key only.
For 14 days, support teams get access to collaboration tools such as real-time dashboards, self-service features
For all trial users, there is a default API limit of 50 calls/minute.
Freshdesk's APIs belong to the Representational State Transfer (REST) category.
Freshworks MCP integration is currently in Beta and available through an Early Access Program (EAP) for selected customers on the Enterprise plan.
Webhooks can be triggered via the automation rules that run on ticket creation and rules that run on ticket updates in Freshdesk.

record.open_questions: Exact production (post-EAP, post-GA) pricing/plan requirement for the official MCP server is not yet published; current limits (100 calls/min, 5,000 actions/month) are explicitly stated as EAP-only and subject to change.
